title: Carrier detail page with tabs, dispatch terms, and onboarding status
description: Build the carrier detail page with tabbed layout matching the carrier_details.png design. Header shows carrier name, type badge, status badge, and action buttons (Edit, Dispatch Load disabled placeholder). Summary bar: MC/DOT, contact, dispatch fee, driver count, lifetime revenue placeholder, COI expiry. Tabs: Overview (company info + performance placeholders), Drivers & Vehicles (mini data grids linking to detail pages), Load History (placeholder), Documents (placeholder), Billing (placeholder). Right sidebar: Dispatch Terms card (fee %, split %, payment terms, agreement date), Onboarding Status checklist (with green checks or missing warnings), Notes section. Insurance expiry warning banner when within 30 days. Use MainCard, PageHeader, Tabs from @mocho/ui.
acceptanceCriteria: CarrierDetailPage fetches carrier by ID from URL params; shows loading state via PageWrapper isLoading
Page header shows carrier name, avatar initials, type badge (External Carrier / Company Asset), status badge (Approved/Active), Edit button opening CarrierFormDialog
Summary bar displays: MC#/DOT#, primary contact name + phone, dispatch fee %, driver count (available/total), lifetime revenue placeholder ($0), COI expiry date

Overview tab: Company Information card (Legal Name, DOT, Contact, Email, MC, Address, Phone, Equipment types), Performance (All Time) section with placeholder cards (Total Loads: 0, Revenue: $0, Avg Rate/Mi: —, On-Time %: —, Avg Days Out: —)

Drivers & Vehicles tab: mini DataGrid of carrier's drivers (name, phone, home, status — rows link to /fleet/drivers/:id) and mini DataGrid of vehicles (unit#, make/model, type, status — rows link to /fleet/vehicles/:id) with 'Add Driver' and 'Add Vehicle' buttons
Load History tab: placeholder EmptyState component ('Load history will appear here')
Documents tab: placeholder EmptyState component ('Documents will appear here')
Right sidebar — Dispatch Terms card: Dispatch Fee %, Partner Split % (hidden for DISPATCHER role), Payment Terms, Agreement signed date

Right sidebar — Onboarding Status: for EXTERNAL_CARRIER shows checklist (Dispatch Agreement, Certificate of Insurance, W-9, MC/DOT Verified) with green check or red missing icon; fetches from GET /carriers/:id/onboarding
Right sidebar — Notes section with carrier.notes displayed as read-only text
Insurance expiry warning banner: yellow alert when within 30 days, red when expired, with expiry date
Back navigation: arrow button navigates to /fleet/carriers
validationCommand: npm run lint --workspace=hussle-app-dispatch-ui && npm run check-ts --workspace=hussle-app-dispatch-ui && npm run test --workspace=hussle-app-dispatch-ui
